solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Escargots? Certainly not!

parts.note: surface reading: snails served as a French delicacy
setter's reading: snails are famously slow, so a dish of them is the opposite of quick-service grub

explanation.walkthrough: The joke turns on snails being slow: whatever escargots are, they are not the speedy kind of meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Burgers and chips served quickly are the opposite of anything slow, and snails are the byword for slowness.

clue.text: Part of course that's just fashion

parts.note: just and fair both mean even-handed
a fashion is a manner or way of doing something

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that a new trend is only a passing part of the course of things.
explanation.definitionFit: On a golf course, this is the mown stretch between tee and green.

clue.text: Drunk also swallowing very many shots

indicators.note: to swallow something is to take it inside, so one piece goes within the other
a drunk staggers about, so the letters of the word beside it are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
V is the standard abbreviation for very

explanation.surface: A drunk downs a great many shots of liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shots' looks like drinks to the drunk, but here they are gunfire.
explanation.definitionFit: A salvo is a simultaneous discharge of many guns or missiles.

clue.text: Spotlight pro, say, on game of golf

parts.note: pro means in favour of
e.g., for example, is what 'say' means in 'say, a cat'
a full game of golf is a round

explanation.surface: A golf professional is put in the spotlight during a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pro, say' tempts a homophone of FORE, the golfer's warning, but 'say' is just EG.
explanation.definitionFit: To foreground something is to give it prominence, the verb sense of spotlighting it.

clue.text: Person making deliveries from part of laboratory

indicators.note: taking only a part of the following word means the letters sit inside it

parts.note: the letters run consecutively in the middle of this word

explanation.surface: Someone delivering supplies comes from a section of the lab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deliveries' suggests parcels, but here it means speeches delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: A public speaker is said to deliver speeches, so a speech-maker makes deliveries.

clue.text: What sounds like distress call from rider to stop

indicators.note: says outright that the answer is pronounced like the word for distress

parts.note: woe is misery or distress

explanation.surface: A rider in trouble shouts a distress call to halt the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse riders shout this word to make a horse slow down or halt.

clue.text: Journalist understood tool for cutting

parts.note: a hack is a jobbing journalist
'I saw' means I understood

explanation.surface: A reporter grasped what a cutting tool was for.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacksaw is a fine-toothed saw used to cut metal.

clue.text: A flower got from bed

parts.note: taken as written
a rose is a flower

explanation.surface: A flower was picked from a garden bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The flower bed is a garden bed in the surface, but the definition means getting up out of a bed to sleep in.
explanation.definitionFit: To get up from bed in the morning is to rise; this is its past tense.

clue.text: Handle badly — this round's on me?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to abuse or mistreat
second meaning, split differently: what someone says offering to buy the drinks

explanation.walkthrough: Split after the third letter, the hyphenated word becomes 'I'll treat', the words of someone buying a round in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: To mistreat or abuse someone is to handle them badly; the split form is an offer to pay.

clue.text: Finishes off the music with no repetition of sound

indicators.note: finishes are ends, so only the final letter of each word is kept

parts.note: the final letter of each of these four words

explanation.surface: Someone ends the music without any repeated passages.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo is a sound reflected back so that it is heard again.

clue.text: Lead, for example, one kind of band

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a dense metallic element such as lead
second meaning: a loud style of rock group

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' reads as the lead singer of a band, but it is the metal Pb.
explanation.definitionFit: Lead and mercury are dense elements called this, and the same phrase names a loud genre of rock music.

clue.text: Grown improperly, right? On the contrary

indicators.note: something done improperly is done incorrectly, so the letters are out of order

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a plant was raised in the right way, and gets told it was not.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposite of right, or correct, is incorrect.

clue.text: Monitor where bishop has authority

definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: above a diocese, which is a bishop's see

explanation.walkthrough: A see is the district a bishop governs, so the bishop's power is 'over see'.
explanation.definitionFit: To supervise or keep watch on something is to monitor it.

clue.text: Like canary or chicken

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the colour of a canary

explanation.walkthrough: Both look like birds, but chicken is slang for cowardly.
explanation.definitionFit: Canaries are this bright colour, and a coward is called this in slang.

clue.text: Apprentice, one who's being paid under pound

indicators.note: in a down entry, lying under something means coming after it in the column

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from the Latin libra
an earner is someone who receives pay

explanation.surface: A trainee is paid less than a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: An apprentice is someone still learning a trade.

clue.text: Audibly, what could be you or I making assertion

indicators.note: audibly means as heard, so the answer is a word that is pronounced like the phrase described

parts.words: what could be you or I
parts.note: U and I, which sound like you and I, are both vowels

explanation.surface: Someone speaking out loud asserts something about either of two people.
explanation.walkthrough: You and I look like people, but they stand for the letters U and I.
explanation.definitionFit: An avowal is an open declaration or statement of something.

clue.text: Awfully valiant citizen of Northern Europe

indicators.note: something done awfully is done badly, so the letters are messed up

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A very brave person from the Baltic.
explanation.definitionFit: Latvia is a Baltic state in northern Europe, and its citizens bear this name.

clue.text: Bright article found in sea

indicators.note: something found in a place is inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: the briny is a jocular name for the sea
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A shining object is discovered in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright person is clever, which is what this adjective means.

clue.text: Something racehorse needs, a kind of shoe

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the person who prepares horses for racing
second meaning: a sports shoe, what Americans call a sneaker

explanation.walkthrough: A horse's shoe suggests a horseshoe, but the second meaning is a running shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: Racehorses are prepared by a professional coach, and the same word is British for a sneaker.

clue.text: Namely, what to do with broken-down car

definitions.meaning: first meaning: that is to say

definitions.text: what to do with broken-down car
definitions.meaning: second meaning, split differently: haul the vehicle away

explanation.walkthrough: Respaced, the phrase becomes 'tow it', what a recovery truck does to a car that has broken down.
explanation.definitionFit: This formal phrase introduces a specification, just as namely or that is does.

clue.text: Power and will possibly

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the modal verb of possibility

explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like willpower, but here it is the auxiliary verb, hedged into possibility.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means great strength, and the verb expresses that something may happen.

clue.text: Carefully prepare man starting union

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to tend or make ready
second meaning: the bridegroom entering a marriage

explanation.walkthrough: 'Union' suggests a trade union, but it is a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: To prime someone for a role, or to tidy an animal's coat, is this verb; the noun is a bridegroom.

clue.text: Footballer on one side or another

definitions.text: Footballer on one side or another

parts.note: surface reading: a player who belongs to one team
setter's reading: a player positioned out on the left or the right flank of the pitch

explanation.walkthrough: 'Side' reads as a team, but it means a flank of the pitch: this player plays out wide, left or right.
explanation.definitionFit: A football player stationed near the touchline on either flank is called by this position name.

clue.text: Tours all over the place, surrounded by seven experts

indicators.note: being surrounded means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: seven in Roman numerals

indicators.note: scattered all over the place means the letters are in disorder

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Seven expert performers go on tour all around the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtuosi are performers, especially musicians, of outstanding skill.

clue.text: Revolutionary act or performance on stage

explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' suggests politics, but it means rotating.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotation is this noun, and so is a single variety performer's act on stage.

clue.text: In revised order, cancel my plant

indicators.note: putting things in a revised order means rearranging them

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone revising a garden order cancels their plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The cyclamen is a flowering plant with swept-back petals, popular as a houseplant.
